title: SVarM: Linear Support Varifold Machines for Classification and Regression on Geometric Data
abstract: arXiv:2506.01189v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite progress in the rapidly developing field of geometric deep learning, performing statistical analysis on geometric data--where each observation is a shape such as a curve, graph, or surface--remains challenging due to the non-Euclidean nature of shape spaces, which are defined as equivalence classes under invariance groups. Building machine learning frameworks that incorporate such invariances, notably to shape parametrization, is often crucial to ensure generalizability of the trained models to new observations. This work proposes \textit{SVarM} to exploit varifold representations of shapes as measures and their duality with test functions $h:\mathbb{R}^n \times S^{n-1} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$. This method provides a general framework akin to linear support vector machines but operating instead over the infinite-dimensional space of varifolds. translated_title: SVarM：用于几何数据分类与回归的线性支持变褶皱机
translated_abstract: 尽管几何深度学习这一快速发展的领域已取得诸多进展，但对几何数据——即每个观测值都是一个形状（如曲线、图或曲面）——进行统计分析仍然充满挑战，原因在于形状空间具有非欧几里得性质，其被定义为在不变群作用下的等价类。构建能够融入这些不变性（尤其是对形状参数化的不变性）的机器学习框架，对于确保训练模型对新观测数据的泛化能力往往至关重要。本工作提出 SVarM 方法，利用形状作为测度的变褶皱表示，及其与测试函数 h: ℝⁿ × Sⁿ⁻¹ → ℝ 之间的对偶性。该方法提供了一个类似于线性支持向量机的通用框架，但其运算是在无穷维的变褶皱空间上进行的。我们通过引入……在形状数据集上构建了分类与回归模型。
tldr: 该论文提出SVarM方法，借助形状的变褶皱测度表示及其对偶性，构建了一个在无穷维变褶皱空间上运算、类似线性支持向量机的通用框架，用于对几何形状数据进行分类与回归。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SVarM, a general framework analogous to linear support vector machines that operates over infinite-dimensional varifold spaces by exploiting varifold representations of shapes, enabling classification and regression on geometric shape data.
